title: Fourier degree of an affine linear form
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $a_0\in\mathbb R$, and let $a_1,\ldots,a_n\in\mathbb R$. The Fourier degree of the function $x\mapsto a_0+\sum_{i=1}^n a_i x_i$ on $\{\pm1\}^n$ is at most $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ assigns a real coefficient to each of the $n$ coordinates
